# TID-CMM

Canonical name: Threat-Informed Detection Capability Maturity Model
Canonical website: https://tid-cmm.com
Canonical model version: 1.5.0
Author: Reza Adineh
Relationship: TID-CMM is the detection measurement module of UTIOM (https://utiom.de). TIR-CMM (https://tir-cmm.com) is the response measurement companion.

TID-CMM asks: Would the organisation actually see the adversaries most likely to attack it?

Core logic:
Relevant adversaries -> crown jewels and attack paths -> in-scope MITRE ATT&CK behaviours -> required telemetry -> telemetry assurance -> detection engineering -> adversarial validation -> measurable improvement.

Model structure:
- 8 domains
- 58 sub-capabilities
- 348 level descriptors
- scores 0-5
- 5 integrity constraints
- MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2
- three assessment depths: Rapid, Structured, Evidence-based
- no certification scheme
